typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Id as integer,
		AsOfDate as timestamp,
		Client as integer,
		Category as string,
		Source as string,
		ItemCount3 as integer,
		NetValue3 as decimal(18,2),
		ItemCount7 as integer,
		NetValue7 as decimal(18,2),
		ItemCount15 as integer,
		NetValue15 as decimal(18,2),
		ItemCount30 as integer,
		NetValue30 as decimal(18,2),
		ItemCount60 as integer,
		NetValue60 as decimal(18,2),
		ItemCount90 as integer,
		NetValue90 as decimal(18,2),
		ItemCount120 as integer,
		NetValue120 as decimal(18,2),
		ItemCount180 as integer,
		NetValue180 as decimal(18,2),
		{ItemCount180+} as integer,
		{NetValue180+} as decimal(18,2),
		TotalCount as integer,
		TotalValue as decimal(18,2),
		DateAdded as timestamp,
		DateModified as timestamp,
		UserId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		AsOfDate as timestamp,
		Id as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@AsOfDate == LookupLKPTABLE@AsOfDate && OLEDBSource@Id == LookupLKPTABLE@Id,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		loadDate = loadDate,
		Id = OLEDBSource@Id,
		AsOfDate = OLEDBSource@AsOfDate,
		Client = Client,
		Category = Category,
		Source = Source,
		ItemCount3 = ItemCount3,
		NetValue3 = NetValue3,
		ItemCount7 = ItemCount7,
		NetValue7 = NetValue7,
		ItemCount15 = ItemCount15,
		NetValue15 = NetValue15,
		ItemCount30 = ItemCount30,
		NetValue30 = NetValue30,
		ItemCount60 = ItemCount60,
		NetValue60 = NetValue60,
		ItemCount90 = ItemCount90,
		NetValue90 = NetValue90,
		ItemCount120 = ItemCount120,
		NetValue120 = NetValue120,
		ItemCount180 = ItemCount180,
		NetValue180 = NetValue180,
		{ItemCount180+} = {ItemCount180+},
		{NetValue180+} = {NetValue180+},
		TotalCount = TotalCount,
		TotalValue = TotalValue,
		DateAdded = DateAdded,
		DateModified = DateModified,
		UserId = UserId
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		ItemCount120 as integer,
		NetValue60 as integer,
		Category as string,
		NetValue180 as integer,
		NetValue180_ as integer,
		NetValue120 as integer,
		Source as string,
		NetValue7 as integer,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TotalValue as integer,
		ItemCount30 as integer,
		Client as integer,
		ItemCount90 as integer,
		ItemCount180 as integer,
		ItemCount7 as integer,
		NetValue90 as integer,
		ItemCount3 as integer,
		ItemCount15 as integer,
		ItemCount180_ as integer,
		AsOfDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NetValue3 as integer,
		TotalCount as integer,
		UserId as string,
		NetValue15 as integer,
		ItemCount60 as integer,
		Id as integer,
		DateAdded as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NetValue30 as integer,
		DateModified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ItemCount120,
		NetValue60,
		Category,
		NetValue180,
		NetValue180_ = {NetValue180+},
		NetValue120,
		Source,
		NetValue7,
		loadDate,
		TotalValue,
		ItemCount30,
		Client,
		ItemCount90,
		ItemCount180,
		ItemCount7,
		NetValue90,
		ItemCount3,
		ItemCount15,
		ItemCount180_ = {ItemCount180+},
		AsOfDate,
		NetValue3,
		TotalCount,
		UserId,
		NetValue15,
		ItemCount60,
		Id,
		DateAdded,
		NetValue30,
		DateModified),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
